description: [Nigeria Health Watch] It is not surprising that the fight against COVID-19 has introduced a great deal of military metaphors in the media globally. The world has been at war with a virus and from the outset, healthcare workers of different cadres have been at the frontline of defense between the people and the virus. They are the ones who must report to work in the face of known and unknown threats to their physical health and this has earned them the term -- Frontline Workers.
title: Africa: No Retreat No Surrender - Celebrating Frontline Responders in the Fight Against Covid-19 in Africa

description: [This Day] The Nigeria Inter-Bank Settlement System (NIBSS) Plc, has retained its position as Africa's only mature inclusive instant payment system, with its NIBSS Instant Payment (NIP) platform once again earning the highest inclusivity rating in the fifth edition of AfricaNenda's State of Inclusive Instant Payment Systems (SIIPS) in Africa Report 2026.
title: Africa: NIBSS Retains Position As Africa's Inclusive Instant Payment System
